title: Analysis code and derived data for "Weak and species-specific morphological change in Atlantic Forest birds across two decades of warming"
description:
Analysis code, derived analytical data sets, pooled posterior summaries of the Stan models and the REML (glmmTMB) result objects, reproducing every value reported in a study of morphological change in 73 Atlantic Forest passerine species across 24 years (1995–2018) of regional warming.

Licensing. The code (Analysis/scripts/, Manuscript/) is released under the MIT licence. The derived data, result objects, figures and manuscript text are released under CC BY 4.0, with one exception: Analysis/data/external/jirinec2021_tableS6.csv, transcribed from the supplementary Table S6 of Jirinec et al. 2021 (Science Advances), keeps its source licence, CC BY-NC 4.0. The Zenodo record licence below is set to CC BY 4.0 as the more demanding of the two main licences; see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.md in the deposit for the exact split.

Primary data sources, each of which should be cited in its own right: ATLANTIC BIRD TRAITS (Rodrigues et al. 2019, Ecology, no copyright or proprietary restrictions); EltonTraits 1.0 (Wilman et al. 2014, Ecology, no restrictions); the avian phylogeny of McTavish et al. 2025 (PNAS, CC BY 4.0); WorldClim 2.1 downscaled from CRU-TS 4.09 (Fick & Hijmans 2017; Harris et al. 2020); and, for the comparison with the central Amazon, Table S6 of Jirinec et al. 2021 (Science Advances, CC BY-NC 4.0).

What is not included. Third-party raw data are not redistributed. WorldClim's terms forbid redistribution without prior permission, so no file containing per-record WorldClim values is deposited; Analysis/scripts/climate_extraction.R rebuilds them from a WorldClim download. The per-tree Stan fits (several GB) are omitted; their pooled posterior summaries are included, and the scripts and job files refit them. Large brms model objects from a superseded engine (~2 GB) are also omitted. Every number in the manuscript and supplementary material renders from the deposit alone.
